author: Petlas
body:
Name of player being reported: King_Beast713
Rule broken: Hacked client - Flying.
Evidence: Click here.
Anything else you would like to add?:
I apologise if the evidence isn't clear enough - This video was recorded by someone else.

There are two hackers in this game - Johnny152004 and King_Beast713, one of which has been banned already. At the start of the video you can see two fly hackers flying around the other team's spawn and creating several visible kill logs in the chat, all of which belong to these two (mostly). There's also a point at 1:00 where you can see King killing about three people whilst his kill logs come up in the chat simultaneously, but he's moving too fast to get a proper glimpse of his name tag.

Thank you in advance!
